title: Rider not connecting to LSP Server
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.6.stable.flathub [89cea1439]

### System information

Fedora 43 Godot v4.6.stable (89cea1439) - Freedesktop SDK 25.08 (Flatpak runtime) on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7700S (RADV NAVI33) - AMD Ryzen 9 7940HS w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (16 threads) - 30.64 GiB memory

### Issue description

Hey, when I try to use Rider with the new 4.6 version of Godot, it tries to connect to the LSP Server for a while, but ultimately fails with this error. Any ideas why?

### Steps to reproduce

- Open Godot 4.6
- configure it to use Rider as an external Text Editor
- open any script in Rider
- observer Rider being unable to connect
